raw_snippet: Among newly-recruited developers the estimated speedup is -4%, with a confidence interval between -15% and +9%.
dispute_text: METR itself calls this 'very weak evidence' because developers refusing the no-AI arm biases the sample.
note: Feb 2026 redesign, 57 developers, 143 repos, 800+ tasks; returning 2025 developers measured -18% (CI -38% to +9%).
